scope: Reviewed GPUI Kit 0.8.1 default Assets source, compiled into the native application. Include full Lucide ISC/Feather MIT attribution. System-selected fonts are not redistributed. New asset selection or dependency versions require review.
font_policy: No application font files are bundled by the current application. GPUI svg renderer requests optional assets from its asset source; the configured default GPUI Kit Assets source contains only default-icons.txt SVGs. IBM Plex/Lilex include_bytes references in gpui-pre svg_renderer are cfg(test), not this production build.
